'''2022 Toola Regionals Quirin Fürgut DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Quirin Fürgut]] at [[2022 Regional Championships]].

* '''Player:''' [[Quirin Fürgut]]
* '''Event:''' [[2022 Regional Championships]]

* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
